dialogue.content: (宜しくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.content: （こんばんは。こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. I look forward to it as well.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。来ていただき、ありがとうございます。最初に、年齢・性別・ご相談内容をお聞かせください。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: こんばんは。48歳、女家事や子育て、仕事で疲れ果ててしまいました
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm 48 years old, female. I'm completely exhausted from housework, raising my children, and work.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂き、ありがとうございます。そうでしたか。やることが沢山ありすぎて、疲れてしまったのですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. I see. It sounds like you have so much to do that you've become exhausted.

dialogue.content: お子さんは、何人で何歳でしょうか?
dialogue.English: How many children do you have, and how old are they?

dialogue.content: はい。子どもは2人で14歳と6歳です
dialogue.English: Yes. I have two children, ages 14 and 6.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。下のお子さんは、まだまだ手がかかりそうですね。お仕事は何をされていますか?
dialogue.English: I see. Your younger child probably still needs a lot of care. What kind of work do you do?

dialogue.content: 在宅でオンラインでの保健指導の仕事をしています
dialogue.English: I work from home, providing online health guidance.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。在宅だと、通勤時間がかからないので、少しは良いのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. Since you work from home and don't have to commute, does that help a little?

dialogue.content: そうですね。その点ではよいと思います。子どもが休んでいても仕事はできますし
dialogue.English: Yes, that's a good point. In that respect, it's helpful because I can still work even if my children are home from school.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。でも大変なお仕事ですよね。家事等については、ご主人様と、何か分担しあって、という感じでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. But it sounds like a demanding job. As for housework and other chores, do you and your husband share the responsibilities in some way?

dialogue.content: 主人は春から別の件で仕事をしています
dialogue.English: My husband has been working in another prefecture since spring.

dialogue.content: 件→県です
dialogue.English: I meant 'prefecture,' not 'matter.'

dialogue.content: そうですか。今は相談者様が、お一人で全部こなしていらっしゃるのですね?
dialogue.English: I see. So at the moment, you're handling everything on your own?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは本当に、お辛いことも多いかと思います。上のお子様は、14歳、ということは、中学三年生でしょうか?
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you in many ways. Your older child is 14, which means they're in the third year of junior high school?

dialogue.content: 中学二年生です
dialogue.English: They're in the second year of junior high school.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、失礼いたしました。相談者様の状況に理解を示してくれる年齢かと思いますが、家のことは少し手伝ったり、とかはいかがでしょう?
dialogue.English: Oh, I see, my apologies. I imagine at that age, they might be understanding of your situation. Do they help out a little with household chores?

dialogue.content: ゴミ捨てや弟の世話などはやってくれます。
dialogue.English: They take out the trash and help look after their younger brother.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。頼もしいですね。手伝ってくれると、その気持ちだけでも嬉しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That’s reassuring. Just their willingness to help is heartening, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s true.

dialogue.content: とはいえ、お一人で全部抱え込んでいらっしゃるのは日々疲れると思います。今どのようなお気持ちでしょう?
dialogue.English: That being said, I imagine shouldering everything by yourself day after day must be exhausting. How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.content: 家事、育児、仕事をこなすのに精一杯で自分に余裕がなく子どもの事もよく見てあげられていない
dialogue.English: I'm so overwhelmed with managing housework, childcare, and my job that I have no emotional capacity for myself, and I feel I'm not able to look after my children properly.

dialogue.content: 申し訳ないし、このままでいいのかという気持ちです
dialogue.English: I feel guilty and wonder if it’s okay to keep going like this.

dialogue.content: あとなんで自分だけ1人でこんなにやらなきゃならないのか
dialogue.English: Also, why do I have to do all this by myself?

dialogue.content: そのようなお気持ちなのですね。こんなに一生懸命がんばっていらっしゃって。ご自身を責めるお気持ちと怒りもあるのですね。ちなみに、ご主人様はどれくらいの頻度で帰省されるのでしょう?
dialogue.English: I understand that's how you feel. You're trying so incredibly hard. It sounds like you're feeling both self-blame and anger. By the way, how often does your husband come home?

dialogue.content: 月に1、2回ですだいたい息子の習い事の大会があると帰省しますお金がかかるので月1でと約束したのですが…
dialogue.English: Once or twice a month. He usually comes home when our son has a competition for his extracurricular activity. We agreed on once a month because of the cost, but...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…。帰られた時だけでも家のことをしてもらえると助かると思いますが、どのような状況でしょう?
dialogue.English: I see... I imagine it would be a big help if he could at least handle some household tasks when he's back. What is that like in practice?

dialogue.content: 帰ってきたときは子どもの習い事の送迎などはやってくれます
dialogue.English: When he’s home, he does things like driving the kids to and from their activities.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。子煩悩なご主人様なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. He sounds like a doting father.

dialogue.content: 相談者様の家庭の事情を、職場の上司に相談して、子育てがひと段落するまで、仕事量を減らしてもらうことは出来そうでしょうか?
dialogue.English: Would it be possible to speak with your supervisor about your family situation and ask to have your workload reduced until childcare settles down a bit?

dialogue.content: 子どもしか相手してくれないから子どもが可愛いのだと思います
dialogue.English: I think he's so doting on the children because they're the only ones who pay him any attention.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 仕事を減らすのは相談できそうです
dialogue.English: I think I could probably talk to them about reducing my work.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。ちょっと不仲な雰囲気が伝わってきますが、ご主人様が帰ってこられた時に、不満が先に出てしまうのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. I'm sensing some friction between you. When your husband comes home, does your frustration tend to come out first?

dialogue.content: はい。でます。
dialogue.English: Yes, it does.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。こんなに苦労されているのだから、ご主人様から、いつも大変だね、等の労いの言葉が欲しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Since you're going through so much, you must want to hear some words of appreciation from your husband, like, "You're always working so hard."

dialogue.content: この状況になったのが主人がここ数年で5回も転職したからなので、不満はずっとありますもちろん労いもないです
dialogue.English: This whole situation is because my husband has changed jobs five times in the last few years, so I've been frustrated for a long time. And of course, there are no words of appreciation.

dialogue.content: それはやりきれないですよね…。ご自身をいたわるために、たまには、ご飯をつくらない日を設けて、その日はお弁当とか、スーパーの総菜等にする、とかして、ご自身の時間が作れたらいいですよね。
dialogue.English: That must be unbearable... To take care of yourself, it would be good to have days where you don't cook, and instead get takeout or prepared foods from the supermarket to make some time for yourself.

dialogue.content: それは時々ですがやっています
dialogue.English: I do that sometimes.

dialogue.content: 主人は仕事だけしていればよくて多くのタスクをこなすのは母親として当然なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it just expected of me as a mother to handle so many tasks, while my husband only has to worry about his job?

dialogue.content: 当然とは思いませんが、相談者様が、家のことで手をぬけることがあれば、できるだけ負担にならないように出来たらいいなと思います。相談者様のお子様を思うお気持ちが、お子様達に伝わっていると思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think it's expected at all, but I do think it would be good if you could find ways to lighten your load with housework wherever possible so it doesn't become such a burden. I believe your love for your children is getting through to them.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか…なぜ私だけ子どもたちの習い事の送迎でほぼ毎日、2箇所行ったり一日3往復もしたり、その合間に仕事や食事、家の片付けなどしたりなのでしょうか主人が仕事をちゃんとしてれば私もせめて仕事をしなくて家事育児に専念できるのに
dialogue.English: Do you really think so? Why am I the only one driving the kids to their lessons almost every day, going to two different places, making three round trips a day, all while trying to squeeze in work, meals, and tidying up the house? If my husband just had a steady job, I could at least not have to work and could focus on housework and childcare.

dialogue.content: 子どもは私のストレスを感じでいるだけだと思います
dialogue.English: I think the children are just picking up on my stress.

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなのですね。そうですよね。家事育児に専念できたら、随分と気持ちのストレスはなくなるでしょうが、現実はそうではないのですね。お子様の習い事は、お子様がご希望されているのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: So that's how you see it. I understand. If you could focus solely on housework and childcare, much of the emotional stress would probably disappear, but that isn't the reality of your situation, is it? As for your children's lessons, are those something they wanted to do?

dialogue.content: はい。子どもの希望です。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's what the children want.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。だから頑張って送迎されているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's why you work so hard to take them.

dialogue.content: はい。すみませんまた今度相談に来させていただきたいです。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm sorry, I'd like to come back for another session some other time.

dialogue.content: お話の途中ですが、時間が過ぎてしまいました。申し訳ありません。
dialogue.English: We're in the middle of our conversation, but our time is up. I'm very sorry.

dialogue.content: いえ、またお願いします
dialogue.English: No need to apologize—I’d like to come again.

dialogue.content: またいつでもお話しにいらして下さい。これで終了とさせて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come and talk anytime. Is it all right if we conclude for today?

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
